evals.prompt: Diagram our checkout flow: React SPA, FastAPI gateway, Postgres, Stripe webhooks. Architecture diagram for onboarding docs.
evals.expected_output: Standalone diagram with boundary boxes, intent-labeled relations (POST /pay, webhook order.paid), tech annotations, legend, tight viewBox; pre-delivery gates pass
expectations: Every relation label states intent plus payload, never bare uses/calls
Every container carries its technology annotation
Legend present; no edge crosses a node or label
viewBox tight to content with grid placement

evals.prompt: Draw a RAG pipeline diagram: user query, embedder, vector DB, LLM, response.
evals.expected_output: Agent-workflow diagram with semantic shapes (double-border LLM, hexagon agent if present, cylinder vector store), sync/async arrow discipline, Catppuccin tokens, dark-mode support
expectations: LLM is double-border, vector store is cylinder — shapes carry meaning
Sync vs async edges use solid vs dashed consistently
No invented components beyond the brief (Unknown marked, not drawn as fact)

evals.prompt: Is this C4 container diagram any good? (diagram attached) Update it: split the monolith API into gateway + billing service.
evals.expected_output: Severity-grouped critique first, then updated diagram touching every affected level, with Before/Delta/After facts (added gateway, added billing, moved routes, rerouted webhooks)
expectations: Critique grouped by severity before any redraw
Update touches all affected levels, not a from-scratch redraw

evals.prompt: Sequence diagram for login: client, API gateway, auth service, user DB.
evals.expected_output: Lifelines with activation bars, sync/async arrow discipline, message labels with payloads (POST /login, JWT token), arrow markers defined, no overlapping labels
expectations: Activation bars present where participants are active
Messages labeled with intent plus payload
Vision self-check performed: no clipped text or overlaps
